title: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: ходить, ездить, летать usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb. However, prefixes "по-" and "с-" may form the perfective aspect with the "repeated function" verbs.

a) Prefix "по-" denoting a perfective action of limited duration (an action "for a while"): походить, поездить, полетать. *Он походил по комнате и сел за стол. Мы поездили по городу и поехали домой.* b) Prefix "с-" implying a single round trip: сходить, съездить, слетать. These verbs denote a single trip (going to and coming from a place), especially when a quick return is implied. *Мне надо сходить на почту за письмами. Я съезжу на вокзал и узнаю, когда отходит поезд.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 63.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.why: «при-»: принести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том никогда не ___ (выходить) из дома без сопровождения телохранителей.
exercises.prompt: Tom never leaves his house without being accompanied by bodyguards.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Who's taking the kids to school?
exercises.why: «от-»: отводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He's a little slow on the uptake.
exercises.why: «до-»: доходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A murmur went through the audience.
exercises.why: «про-»: пробежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He escaped under cover of darkness.
exercises.why: «с-»: сбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Is it included in the price?
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Ideas occur to me on the spur of the moment.
exercises.why: «при-»: приходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У неё в одно ухо влетает, в другое ___ (вылетать).
exercises.prompt: With her, it goes in one ear and out the other.
exercises.why: «вы-»: вылетать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Take it to a mechanic, and get it fixed.
exercises.why: «от-»: отнести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Не ___ (переходить) в крайности. Умеренность важна во всём.
exercises.prompt: Don't go to extremes. To be moderate is important in anything.
exercises.why: «пере-»: переходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: проводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Maybe I went a little too far.
exercises.why: «за-»: зайти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom doesn't seem to be leaving.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Thank you for coming to my rescue.
exercises.why: «при-»: прийти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«вы-»: выйти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: «под-»: подбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Кто ___ (перевести) это стихотворение на таджикский язык?
exercises.prompt: Who translated this poem into the Tajik language?
exercises.why: «пере-»: перевести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Did you have a good Easter?
exercises.why: «про-»: провести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I've got a new word processor.
exercises.why: «за-»: завести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
